Sync only copies data from YouTube to Grayjoy. Local changes are not sent to YouTube. Two-way sync is work in progress.
Keep your favorite music
Tap the star in Now Playing or the track menu. Favorites are also available on Home and in Library.
Download a playlist for offline listening
Open a playlist or album and tap Download audio. A spinner means the playlist is already downloading; tapping it will not cancel the job.
Choose the listening order
Open Shuffle & order. Drag tracks or shuffle them, then choose In this order to play without saving, or Save to keep the order. Remote playlists are saved as local copies.
Choose a track, artist, album or recent playlist on Home.
Tap the star to add or remove the current track from favorites.
Tap Download audio. You can follow the job in the jobs panel.
Open Shuffle & order to choose a custom or shuffled track order.
Play in this order, or save the new playlist order.
